scholarship_exists.quote: 1-year scholarships valued between €2,000 to €5,000 each and scholarships valued at €4,000. Scholarships are applied as a reduction to the tuition fees.
scholarship_exists.notes: School-level (E3) award; eligible majors include 'B.A. Computer Science'. The university-wide Global Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship (tcd.ie/study/international/scholarships/undergraduate/geug.php) states that 'computer science and statistics courses are exempt' and points CS applicants to this E3 page. Partial (EUR 2,000-5,000, one year, as a tuition reduction). Batch deadlines printed are for the 2026 cycle (1 February, 15 March, 1 May 2026); 2027-entry dates not yet published.

scholarship_international.quote: Applicants who have non-EU status and will pay tuition fees at the non-EU rate, and hold an offer letter for first year entry into the programmes above.
scholarship_international.notes: Open only to non-EU fee-status applicants with a first-year offer for a listed programme (B.A. Computer Science is listed). Assessed on academic achievement and a 200-word statement.
